info = {
  hpColour = "#6E9299",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

   level = 0

      elseif newValue >= 345 then
         level = 7
      elseif newValue >= 275 then
         level = 6
      elseif newValue >= 210 then

      elseif newValue >= 150 then

      elseif newValue >= 95 then

      elseif newValue >= 45 then

      end
      if level > 0 then
         if buttons["level" .. level].label == "" then Wait.frames(function() clickedToggle("level" .. level) end, 1) end
      end
   end
   Wait.frames(forceSave, 10)
end

    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then

    end
    if health.value < 0 then

      end

      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then

        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then

        end
        if id == "add" then

          else

          end
        end
      end

    setHealth()
  end

  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

   self.UI.setValue("targetVal", targetValue)
   toggleUIActivity("targetPanel", 0 < targetValue)

   -- Attack Effects
   local hasAttackEffect = false
   for _, effect in pairs({"muddle", "poison", "wound", "immobilize", "disarm", "stun", "strengthen", "curse", "pierce", "push", "Advantage", "Attackers gain Disadvantage"}) do
      local val = attributes[effect]
      if (0 < val) then hasAttackEffect = true end
      self.UI.setValue(effect.."Val", val)
      toggleUIActivity(effect.."Effect", 0 < val)
   end
   toggleUIActivity("attackEffectsPanel", hasAttackEffect)


   -- Attack Effects
   local hasImmunity = false
   for _, immunity in pairs({"muddle", "poison", "wound", "immobilize", "disarm", "stun", "curse", "pull", "push"}) do
      if immunities[immunity] then hasImmunity = true end
      toggleUIActivity(immunity.."Immunity", immunities[immunity])
   end
   toggleUIActivity("immunitiesPanel", hasImmunity)
end

function setBossFlag()
   isBoss = true
end

-- Sets the type of monster, stats, and attributes
function setTyp(typ)
   if true ~= isBoss then
      if typ[1] == "normal" then
         self.setColorTint({1, 1, 1})
      else
         self.setColorTint({1, 1, 0})
      end
   end

   local partySheet = nil
   for _, obj in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if obj.getDescription() == "Party Sheet" then
         partySheet = obj
      end
   end
   if partySheet ~= nil then
      local level = tonumber(partySheet.UI.getAttribute("scenarioLevel", "text"))
      local stats = getObjectFromGUID(statsObj).getTable("stats")[getNameWoNumber()][level + 1]

      -- Boss standees have health calculated elsewhere
      if true ~= isBoss then
         stats = stats[typ[1]]
         health.max = stats.health
         health.value = health.max
      end

      -- Set base stats
      move.base = stats.move;
      attack.base = stats.attack;
      range.base = stats.range;

      -- Set attributes
      mAttributes = {}
      if(nil ~= stats.attributes) then
         for _, attr in pairs(stats.attributes) do
            local checkRange = false
            if attr == "Advantage" or attr == "Attackers gain Disadvantage" then
               mAttributes[attr] = 1
            end
            for key, val in string.gmatch(attr, "%%(%w+)%%%s*(%w*)") do
               -- NOTE: retaliate is the only current attribute to use this structure, if more attributes use this structure, a new schema should be designed
               -- Special case for formatting of ranged retaliate
               if true == checkRange then key = "retaliateRange" end

               -- If the attributes are in the list, the monster has them
               mAttributes[key] = tonumber(val) or 1

               -- If the attribute is retaliate, another value will be the range
               if (key == "retaliate") then checkRange = true end
            end
         end
      end


      -- Set immunities
      for k, v in pairs(immunities) do
         immunities[k] = false
      end
      if(nil ~= stats.immunities) then
         for _, attr in pairs(stats.immunities) do
            for key, val in string.gmatch(attr, "%%(%w+)%%") do
               -- If the attributes are in the list, the monster has them
               immunities[key] = true
            end
         end
      end

      -- Old attributes either acquire new values or are set to zero
      for k, v in pairs(attributes) do
         newVal = mAttributes[k]
         attributes[k] = newVal or 0
      end

      updateHealthUI()
      updateCombatUI()
   end
end

function getNameWoNumber()
   local name = self.getName()
   local num = name:match("%d+")
   if num ~= nil then
      return name:sub(1, name:find(num) - 2)
   else
      return name
   end
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#B577B3",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = true
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

  buttonLabels = true

statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

end

    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses

    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth

  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()

  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)

  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then

  end
  return false

  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")

   saved_data = JSON.encode_pretty(data_to_save)

   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         10)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else

info = {
  hpColour = "#E97A2B",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = true
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function onLoad()
  button_parametersL = {}
  button_parametersL.click_function = 'setRDG'
  button_parametersL.function_owner = self
  button_parametersL.label = ''
  button_parametersL.position = {0.06,0.05,-1.2}
  button_parametersL.color = {1, 1, 1, 0.1}
  button_parametersL.width = 350
  button_parametersL.height = 5
  self.createButton(button_parametersL)
end

function setRDG()
  spawn = true
  local pos = self.getPosition()

  local hitlist = Physics.cast({
    origin = {pos[1], pos[2] + 1, pos[3] - 2.5},
    direction = {0, 1., 0},
    type = 3,
    size = {29., 2., 14.},
    max_distance = 0,
    debug = false
  })

  for k,v in pairs(hitlist) do
    if v.hit_object ~= self then
      broadcastToAll("Please clean up Random Dungeon Generator!", "Red")
      spawn = false
      break
    end
  end

  if spawn == true then

    local hitlist = Physics.cast({
      origin = {pos[1] - 7.97, pos[2] + 1., pos[3] + 8.05},
      direction = {0, -1., 0},
      type = 3,
      size = {0.05, 1.75, 0.05},
      max_distance = 0,
      debug = false
    })

    local tile = {}
    for i,j in pairs(hitlist) do
      if j.hit_object.getDescription():find("Location") then
        tile = deepcopy(j.hit_object.call("rdgmapspawn"))
        broadcastToAll("Generating Random Location: " .. j.hit_object.getName() .. ".", "Green")
      else
        broadcastToAll("Please ensure the Location card is in the appropriate place!", "Red")
      end
    end

    if tile.map then
      local mapPosition = {pos[1] + tile.map.position[1], pos[2] + tile.map.position[2], pos[3] + tile.map.position[3]}
      spawnMapTile(tile.map.name, mapPosition, tile.map.orientation)

      tile = tilePositions(tile, mapPosition)
    end

    if tile and tile.obstacles then
      for i,obstacle in ipairs(tile.obstacles) do
        if (obstacle.class == "difficult") then
          spawnDifficultTerrain({ name = obstacle.type }, obstacle.position, obstacle.rotation)
        else
          spawnObstacle(obstacle.type, obstacle.position, obstacle.rotation)
        end

      end
    end

    local positions
    if tile and tile.positions then
      positions = tile.positions
    else
      positions = generateBasePositions(pos)
    end

    local hitlist = Physics.cast({
      origin = {pos[1] + 8.71, pos[2] + 1., pos[3] + 8.05},
      direction = {0, -1., 0},
      type = 3,
      size = {0.05, 1.75, 0.05},
      max_distance = 0,
      debug = false
    })

    local ospawns
    local spawns = {}
    for i,j in pairs(hitlist) do
      if j.hit_object.getDescription():find("Monster") then
        ospawns = j.hit_object.call("rdgmonspawn")

        spawns = cloneMonsterSpawns(ospawns)

        broadcastToAll("Generating Random Monsters: " .. j.hit_object.getName() .. ".", "Green")
      else
        broadcastToAll("Please ensure the Monster card is in the appropriate place!", "Red")
      end
    end

    Wait.time(function() spawnEntities(spawns, positions) end, 3.)

  end
end

function spawnMapTile(name, position, orientation)

    -- infinite bag containing map tiles marked 1-12
    infMBag = getObjectFromGUID("431f08")
    local MapBag = infMBag.takeObject({
      position = {-148.23, 0.65, 72.05},
      smooth = true
    })

    local mapPosition = {position[1], position[2], position[3]}
    for _, obj in pairs(MapBag.getObjects()) do
      if obj.name == name then
        local tile = MapBag.takeObject({
          position = mapPosition,
          rotation = orientation,
          smooth = false,
          callback_function = function(obj)
            obj.setPositionSmooth({mapPosition[1], mapPosition[2] + 0.1, mapPosition[3]})
            obj.setRotationSmooth(orientation, true, true)
          end,
          guid = obj.guid
        })
        tile.use_grid = false
        tile.tooltip = false
      end
    end
    MapBag.destruct()
end

function spawnEntities(spawns, positions)
  playerCountR = -1
  for _, obj in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if obj.getName():find("Player Mat") then
      playerCountR = playerCountR + 1
    end
  end

  for position,spawn in pairs(spawns) do
    if spawn.type == "coin" then
      spawnCoin(positions[position])
    elseif spawn.type == "treasure" then
      spawnTreasure(spawn, positions[position], positions.orientation)
    elseif spawn.type == "hazardous" then
      spawnHazardousTerrain(spawn, positions[position], positions.orientation)
    elseif spawn.type == "trap" then
      spawnTrap(spawn, positions[position], positions.orientation)
    elseif spawn.type == "difficult" then
      spawnDifficultTerrain(spawn, positions[position], positions.orientation)
    elseif spawn.monster then
      spawnMonster(playerCountR, spawn, positions[position])
    end
  end
end

function spawnCoin(position)
  getObjectFromGUID("0206a8").takeObject({
    position = position,
    rotation = {0.00, 180.00, 0.00},
    smooth = false,
    callback_function = function(obj) obj.setPositionSmooth(position) obj.setRotationSmooth({0.00, 180.00, 0.00}) end
  })
end

function spawnTreasure(spawn, position, orientation)
  infTRSbag = getObjectFromGUID("fe14ef")
  local TRSbag1 = infTRSbag.takeObject({
    position = {-142.78, -2.00, 13.09},
    smooth = true
  })
  for _, obj in pairs(TRSbag1.getObjects()) do
    if obj.name:find(spawn.orientation) then
      local TRS1 = TRSbag1.takeObject({
        position = position,
        rotation = orientation,
        smooth = false,
        callback_function = function(obj) obj.setPositionSmooth(position) obj.setRotationSmooth(orientation) end,
        guid = obj.guid
      })
      TRS1.setDescription(spawn.description)
      TRSbag1.destruct()
    end
  end
end

function spawnFromBag(name, description, infiniteBagGuid, position, rotation)
  infiniteBag = getObjectFromGUID(infiniteBagGuid)
  local objectBag = infiniteBag.takeObject({
    position = {-142.78, -2.00, 3.99},
    smooth = true
  })
  for _, obj in pairs(objectBag.getObjects()) do
    if obj.name == name then
      local obj = objectBag.takeObject({
        position = position,
        rotation = rotation,
        smooth = false,
        callback_function = function(obj)
          obj.setPositionSmooth(position)
          obj.setRotationSmooth(rotation, true, true)
        end,
        guid = obj.guid
      })
      if description then
        obj.setDescription(description)
      end
      break
    end
  end
  objectBag.destruct()
end

function spawnObstacle(type, position, rotation)
  spawnFromBag(type, nil, "c912f5", position, rotation)
end
function spawnTrap(spawn, position, orientation)
  spawnFromBag(spawn.name, spawn.description, "0a3abe", position, orientation)
end
function spawnHazardousTerrain(spawn, position, orientation)
  spawnFromBag(spawn.name, nil, "0b51bb", position, orientation)
end
function spawnDifficultTerrain(spawn, position, orientation)
  spawnFromBag(spawn.name, nil, "4efdc4", position, orientation)
end

function spawnMonster(playerCountR, spawn, position)

  local type
  local posH = self.getPosition()

  if playerCountR == 2 then
    type = spawn["two"]
  elseif playerCountR == 3 then
    type = spawn["three"]
  elseif playerCountR == 4 then
    type = spawn["four"]
  end

  if (type ~= "none" and type) then
    local parameter = {}
    --Set Parameters
    parameter.monsterName = spawn.monster.name

    parameter.monsterType = "Standee"
    parameter.monsterDifficulty = type

    parameter.monsterPosition = {position[1], posH[2] +1., position[3]}
    parameter.monsterRotation = {0.00, 0.00, 0.00}

    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("spawnMonster", parameter)
  end
end

function generateBasePositions(pos)
  local positions = {}
  local spawnHeight = 1

  positions["orientation"] = {0.00, 0.00, 0.00}
  positions["1"] = {pos[1] + 4.44, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] + 3.69}
  positions["2"] = {pos[1] + 8.91, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] + 3.69}
  positions["3"] = {pos[1] + 13.37, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] + 3.69}
  positions["4"] = {pos[1] + 4.44, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 0.5}
  positions["5"] = {pos[1] + 8.91, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 0.5}
  positions["6"] = {pos[1] + 13.37, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 0.5}
  positions["7"] = {pos[1] + 4.44, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 4.41}
  positions["8"] = {pos[1] + 8.91, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 4.41}
  positions["9"] = {pos[1] + 13.37, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 4.41}
  positions["10"] = {pos[1] + 4.44, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 8.75}
  positions["11"] = {pos[1] + 8.91, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 8.75}
  positions["12"] = {pos[1] + 13.37, pos[2] + spawnHeight, pos[3] - 8.75}

  return positions
end

-- I don't know why i need to do this, but i do
function cloneMonsterSpawns(spawns)
  local newSpawns = {}
  for p,s in pairs(spawns) do
    if s then
      newSpawns[p] = {
        name=s.name,
        type=s.type,
        two=s.two,
        three=s.three,
        four=s.four,
        description=s.description,
        orientation=s.orientation,
      }
      if s.monster then
        newSpawns[p]["monster"] = {
          name=s.monster.name,
          guid=s.monster.guid,
          bagGuid=s.monster.bagGuid,
          slpos=s.monster.slpos,
          slrot=s.monster.slrot
        }
      end
    end
  end
  return newSpawns
end

function deepcopy(orig)
    local orig_type = type(orig)
    local copy
    if orig_type == 'table' then
        copy = {}
        for orig_key, orig_value in next, orig, nil do
            copy[deepcopy(orig_key)] = deepcopy(orig_value)
        end
        setmetatable(copy, deepcopy(getmetatable(orig)))
    else -- number, string, boolean, etc
        copy = orig
    end
    return copy
end

function tilePositions(tile, mapPosition)
  if tile.positions then
    for k,v in pairs(tile.positions) do
      local oPos  = v
      if k ~= "orientation" then
        tile.positions[k] = {
          mapPosition[1] + oPos[1],
          mapPosition[2] + oPos[2],
          mapPosition[3] + oPos[3],
        }
      end
    end
  end

  if tile.obstacles then
    for k,v in pairs(tile.obstacles) do
      local oPos  = v.position
      v.position = {
        mapPosition[1] + oPos[1],
        mapPosition[2] + oPos[2],
        mapPosition[3] + oPos[3],
      }
    end
  end
  return tile
end

  chosenIndex = tonumber(id)

    local length = #buffer
    local lastComponentSize = length % 3

    if lastComponentSize == 2 then
        local a, b = --[[---@not nil, nil]] table.unpack(buffer, length - 1, length)
        local v = a * 0x10000 + b * 0x100

function Enhancements.findNearestIndex(decalPosition, enhancementInfo)
    local nearestDistance = 42
    local nearestIndex = 1
    decalPosition:setAt("y", 0)
    for i, enhancement in ipairs(enhancementInfo) do
        local x, z = enhancement.position[1], enhancement.position[2]
        local distance = decalPosition:distance(Vector(x, 0, z))
        if distance < nearestDistance then
            nearestDistance = distance
            nearestIndex = i
        end
    end

    return nearestIndex, nearestDistance
end

function Enhancements.addNumberDecal(obj, name, info)
    position = { info.position[1], DecalYCoordinate, info.position[2] }
    obj.addDecal({
        name = tostring(name),
        url = Enhancements.Decals[name],
        position = position,
        rotation = { 90, 180, 0 },
        scale = { 0.16, 0.16, 3.08 }
    })
end
function Enhancements.addEnhancementDecal(obj, name, info)
    position = { info.position[1], DecalYCoordinate, info.position[2] }
    obj.addDecal({
        name = "Enhancement " .. tostring(name),
        url = Enhancements.Decals[name],
        position = position,
        rotation = { 90, 180, 0 },
        scale = { 0.16, 0.16, 3.08 }
    })
end

function Enhancements.removeDecalsByName(card, name)
  local decals = Object.decals(card)
  local decalsToKeep = {}
  for i, decal in ipairs(decals) do
      if not decal.name:find(tostring(name)) then
        table.insert(decalsToKeep, decal)
      end
  end
  card.setDecals(decalsToKeep)
end

cardRotation = { 0, 180, 180 }

----#include Shared/DedupedCards
function filterObjectEnter(enter_object)
    if enter_object.tag == 'Card' then
        if containsCard(enter_object.getName()) then
          enter_object.destruct()
        else
          enter_object.setRotation(cardRotation or { 0, 0, 0 })
          self.putObject(enter_object)
        end
    end
    if enter_object.tag == 'Deck' then
        filterDeck(enter_object)
    end
    return false
end


function filterDeck(deck)
    local remaining = #deck.getObjects()
    for index, card in pairs(deck.getObjects()) do
        if remaining > 1 then
            -- last item will go in as a card, not a deck
            if containsCard(card.name) then
              deck.takeObject({guid = card.guid}).destruct()
            else
              self.putObject(deck.takeObject({
                guid = card.guid,
                rotation = cardRotation or { 0, 0, 0 },
                smooth = false
              }))
            end
        end
        remaining = remaining - 1
    end
end

function containsCard(name)
  for _, v in ipairs(self.getObjects()) do
    if v.name == name then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

---@overload fun(guidName: string, search: seb_Search_Full): tts__Object
---@param guidName string
---@param search seb_Search_Full
---@param isError boolean
---@return tts__Object
local function findComponent(guidName, search, isError)
    if isError == nil then
        isError = true
    end
    local guid = Guid[guidName]

    local byId = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if byId ~= nil then
        return --[[---@not nil]] byId
    end

    local bySearch = Search.inAllObjects(search)
    if bySearch ~= nil then
        Guid[guidName] = (--[[---@not nil]] bySearch).getGUID()
        return --[[---@not nil]] bySearch
    else
        if isError then
            Logger.error("Fatal error! Can not find component %s", guidName)
        end
    end
end

local MaxColumn = 40
local colCounter = 0
local rowCounter = 0

---@overload fun(): tts__VectorShape
---@param elevation nil | number
---@return tts__Vector
function Component.safePosition(elevation)
    colCounter = colCounter + 1
    local offsetX = colCounter * 3
    local offsetZ = rowCounter * 3

    if colCounter > MaxColumn then
        colCounter = 0
        rowCounter = rowCounter + 1
    end

    return Vector(-23 + offsetX, TableHigh + (elevation or 0), -85 - offsetZ)
end

---@param player number
---@param target number
---@return tts__Vector
function Component.handPosition(player, target)
    if target == 1 then

    if target == 2 then
        return relativeToZone(player, Positions.SecondHand)

end

---@param event nil | string
local function takeFromContainer(container, guid, position, event)
    local object = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if object == nil then
        container.takeObject({
            guid = guid,
            smooth = false,
            position = position,
            rotation = { 0, 180, 0 },
            callback_function = function()
                if event then
                    Wait.frames(function() EventManager.triggerEvent(--[[---@not nil]] event) end, 1)
                end
            end,
        })
    elseif event then
        EventManager.triggerEvent(--[[---@not nil]] event)
    end
end

function Component.replacePlayerButtons()
    Logger.debug("Replacing the functions of the 'Add Player' buttons with custom functionality.")

    ---@param player number
    ---@return string
    local function createScript(player)
        local script = Component.scriptOnManager() ..
                Component.scriptButton({
                    tooltip = "Right click to Remove Player!",
                    click_function = "packBox",
                    position = { 0, 0.05, 0 },
                    width = 2400, height = 600,
                    color = Component.ObjectColor.Invisible
                }) .. [[
function packBox(_, _, alt_click)
    if not alt_click then return end

    if performOnManager("packCharacter", { position = self.getPosition(), bguid = self.getGUID(),  player = ]] .. tostring(player) .. [[ }) then
        self.setState(1)
    end
end]]
        return script
    end

    ---@param player number
    ---@param buttonGuid string
    ---@param isAddButton boolean
    local function replaceButton(player, buttonGuid, isAddButton)
        local button = getObjectFromGUID(buttonGuid)
        if not button then
            return
        end

        local data = (--[[---@not nil]] button).getData()
        local script = createScript(player)

        if isAddButton then
            (--[[---@not nil]] data.States)[2].LuaScript = script
        else
            data.LuaScript = script
        end

        Object.respawn(data)
    end

    for i, addGuid in ipairs(addPlayerButtonsGuids()) do
        replaceButton(i, addGuid, true)
    end

    for i, removeGuid in ipairs(removePlayerButtonsGuids()) do
        replaceButton(i, removeGuid, false)
    end
end

local placingInactive = false

---@overload fun(character: gh_Save_Character, callback: tts__ObjectCallbackFunction): void
---@param character gh_Save_Character
---@param callback tts__ObjectCallbackFunction
function Component.placeInactiveCharacter(character, callback, position)
    local script = Component.scriptOnManager() .. [[
function onCollisionEnter(info)
    if info.collision_object.getName():find("]] .. Names.PlayerMat .. [[") then
        performOnManager("unpackCharacter", { guid = self.getGUID(), character = self.script_state })
    end
end]]

    local characterBoxData = --[[---@type tts__ModelCustomState]] Component.characterBox(--[[---@not nil]] Component.classBox(character.class))
    local characterBox = ObjectState.model({
        type = Object.ModelType.Bag,
        name = character.name,
        description = "Inactive Character Box - Drop on player mat to load - Do NOT alter content",
        mesh = characterBoxData.CustomMesh.MeshURL,
        diffuse = characterBoxData.CustomMesh.DiffuseURL,
        tint = characterBoxData.ColorDiffuse,
        state = character,
        script = script,
        tags = { Component.Tag.InactiveCharacter },
    }, {
        position = Component.safePosition(),
        rotation = { 0, 270, 0 },
        scale = Scales.CharacterBox,
    })

    ---@return tts__NumVectorShape
    local function findFreePosition()
        for i = 1, 20 do
            local xPos = Positions.InactiveCharacter[1] - ((i - 1) * 3)
            local hit = Physics.cast({
                type = 1,
                origin = { xPos, TableHigh + 1, Positions.InactiveCharacter[3] },
                direction = { 0, 1, 0 },
                max_distance = 10,
            })
            if TableUtil.isEmpty(hit) then
                return { xPos, Positions.InactiveCharacter[2], Positions.InactiveCharacter[3] }
            end
        end
    end
    Wait.condition(function()
        placingInactive = true
        if not position then
            position = findFreePosition()
        end
        if not position then
            Logger.error("No free space to spawn inactive character correctly. Dropping it in the middle of the table")
            position = { 0, TableHigh + 1, 0 }
        end
        spawnObjectData({
            data = characterBox,
            position = position,
            callback_function = function(spawned)
                callback(spawned)
                Wait.time(function() placingInactive = false end, 0.5)
            end,
        })
    end, function() return not placingInactive end)
end

            or not Object.description(object):find(className)
            or name:find(Names.AttackModifierCard)
    then
        return nil
    end

    local cardName = StringUtil.replace(name, "%s?[%(%)]%d%d[%)%(]")
    local nearest, _ = Game.ability(className, cardName)
    if nearest then
        return (--[[---@not nil]] nearest).name
    end

            or not Object.description(object):find(className)
            or name:find(Names.AttackModifierCard)

function Component.adjustPlayerMatSnapPoints(playerMat)
    ---@param snaps tts__ObjectState_SnapPoint[]
    ---@param zPosition number

        table.insert(snaps, {
            Position = { x = 1.52, y = 0.1, z = zPosition },
            Tags = {},
        })
    end

    local snaps = --[[---@not nil]] playerMat.AttachedSnapPoints
    addSnapPoint(snaps, -0.72)
    addSnapPoint(snaps, -0.24)
    addSnapPoint(snaps, 0.24)
    addSnapPoint(snaps, 0.72)

    if playerMat.States then
        for _, state in pairs(--[[---@not nil]] playerMat.States) do
            Component.adjustPlayerMatSnapPoints(state)
        end
    end

---@param player number
---@param character gh_Save_Character
---@param object tts__ObjectState
---@param component gh_PlayerComponent
function Component.placePlayerComponent(player, character, object, component)
    local position
    if component.snapPoint then
        position = Utils.getSnapPosition(Component.playerMat(player), --[[---@not nil]] component.snapPoint)
    else
        position = relativeToZone(player, --[[---@not nil]] component.position)
    end

    spawnObjectData({
        data = object,
        position = position:add({ x = 0, y = 1, z = 0 }),
        rotation = component.rotation,
        callback_function = function(obj)
            if component.locked then
                obj.setLock(true)
            end
            if component.event then
                Wait.time(function()
                    EventManager.triggerEvent(--[[---@not nil]] component.event, obj, player, character)
                end, 1)
            end
        end,
    })

            Condition = Positions.CustomConditions,
