info = {
  hpColour = "#DE7E7A",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)

    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

local Enhancements = require("Enhancements")
local Object = require("sebaestschjin-tts.Object")
local StringUtil = require("sebaestschjin-tts.StringUtil")
local TableUtil = require("sebaestschjin-tts.TableUtil")

local EnhancementType = {
  PLUS = "Plus1",
  CONDITION = "Condition",
  BUFF = "Buff",
  JUMP = "Jump",
  ELEMENT = "Element",
  HEX = "Hex",
}

local EnhancementForAbility = {
  move = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.JUMP, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  attack = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.CONDITION, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  range = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  shield = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.BUFF, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  push = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.CONDITION, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  pull = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.CONDITION, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  pierce = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  retaliate = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.BUFF, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  heal = {EnhancementType.PLUS, EnhancementType.BUFF, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  target = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  teleport = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  summMove = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  summAttack = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  summRange = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  summHp = {EnhancementType.PLUS},
  -- no +1s
  enemyCondition = {EnhancementType.CONDITION, EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  allyCondition = {EnhancementType.BUFF,EnhancementType.ELEMENT,},
  hex = {EnhancementType.HEX},
}

local TypeCost = {
  move = 30,
  attack = 50,
  range = 30,
  shield = 100,
  push = 30,
  pull = 30,
  pierce = 30,
  retaliate = 100,
  heal = 30,
  target = 50,
  teleport = 40,
  summMove = 100,
  summAttack = 100,
  summRange = 50,
  summHp = 50,
  PWC = 75,
  Muddle = 50,
  Immobilize = 100,
  Disarm = 150,
  Buff = 50,
  Jump = 50,
  Element = 100,
  AnyElement = 150,
}

local levelCost = {
  [1] = 0,
  [2] = 25,
  [3] = 50,
  [4] = 75,
  [5] = 100,
  [6] = 125,
  [7] = 150,
  [8] = 175,
  [9] = 200,
}

local existingCost = {
  [1] = 75,
  [2] = 150,
  [3] = 225,
}

local theCard = nil
local className = nil
local abilityCard = {}
local buttons = {}
local chosenIndex

local existingEnhancements = {
  top = {},
  bottom = {},
}

local ClassInfo

function onLoad()
  getClassInfo()
end

function getClassInfo()
  if not ClassInfo then
    ClassInfo = getObjectFromGUID("a60084")
    if not ClassInfo then
      print("Unable to load Class Information")
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

function onCollisionEnter(info)
  if theCard then
    print("Please remove the previous card first")
    return
  end

  if not info or not Object.isCard(info.collision_object) then
    return
  end
  if not getClassInfo() then
    return
  end

  loadEnhancementData(info.collision_object)
end

function onCollisionExit(info)
  if info.collision_object == theCard then
    Enhancements.removeNonEnhancementDecals(info.collision_object)
    reset()
  end

end

function loadEnhancementData(card)
  if card then
    className, abilityCard = ClassInfo.call("getAbilityForUnknownClass", { card = card });
    if not abilityCard then
      print("Unable to get enhancement data for that card")
      return
    end
  end

  theCard = card
  local enhancementCount = 0
  for _, decal in ipairs(Object.decals(card)) do
      local enhancementName = StringUtil.replace(decal.name, "Enhancement ")
      local nearestIndex = Enhancements.findNearestIndex(decal.position, abilityCard.enhancements)
      if abilityCard.enhancements[nearestIndex].side == "T" then
        table.insert(existingEnhancements.top, nearestIndex)
      else
        table.insert(existingEnhancements.bottom, nearestIndex)
      end
  end

  for k, v in pairs(abilityCard.enhancements) do
    if not (TableUtil.contains(existingEnhancements.top, k) or TableUtil.contains(existingEnhancements.bottom, k)) then
      Enhancements.addNumberDecal(card, k, v)
      self.UI.setAttribute("Position" .. k, "active", true)
    end
  end
end


function enhancement(player, id)
  if not abilityCard then
    print("Please put an ability card in the slot first.")
    return
  end
  for k=1,8 do
    self.UI.setAttribute("Selected" .. k, "active", false)
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("Selected" .. id, "active", true)
  local enhancement = abilityCard.enhancements[tonumber(id)]
  if not enhancement then
    for k,v in pairs(getBaseOptions()) do
      self.UI.setAttribute(k, "text", "")
    end
    return
  end
  chosenIndex = tonumber(id)
  local options = getEnhancementOptions(enhancement)

  local isTop = enhancement.side == "T"

  local existing
  if isTop then
    existing = existingEnhancements.top
  else
    existing = existingEnhancements.bottom
  end
  local extraCost = 0
  if #existing > 0 then
   extraCost = existingCost[#existing]
  end
  level = abilityCard.level
  if level == "X" then
    level = 1
  end
  local cardCost = levelCost[level]
  local costByType = {}
  for type,v in pairs(options) do
    if v then
      local multiplier = 1
      if enhancement.multi then
        multiplier = 2
      end

      local baseCost
      if type == "Hex" then
        local extraHexes = 0
        for _,j in pairs(enhancement.otherHex) do
          if TableUtil.contains(existing, j) then
            extraHexes = extraHexes + 1
          end
        end
        baseCost = math.floor(200 / ( enhancement.baseHex + extraHexes) )
        multiplier = 1
      elseif type == "Plus1" then
        baseCost = TypeCost[enhancement.type]
      else
        baseCost = TypeCost[type]
      end
      local finalCost = (baseCost * multiplier) + cardCost + extraCost
      costByType[type] = finalCost
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(getBaseOptions()) do
    self.UI.setAttribute(k, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("panel_" .. k, "active", false)
  end
  for k,v in pairs(costByType) do
    self.UI.setAttribute(k, "text", tostring(v) .. "g")
    self.UI.setAttribute("panel_" .. k, "active", true)
  end
end

function addEnhancement(player, enhancementType)
  split = StringUtil.split(enhancementType, "_")
  baseType = ""
  if #split == 2 then
    baseType = split[1]
    enhancementType = split[2]
  else
    baseType = enhancementType
  end

  local cost = self.UI.getAttribute(baseType, "text")

  local cardName = StringUtil.replace(Object.name(theCard), "%s?[%(%)]%d%d[%)%(]")
  broadcastToAll("Added " .. enhancementType .. " to " .. cardName .. " for " .. cost, "White")

  Enhancements.removeDecalsByName(theCard, tostring(chosenIndex))
  Enhancements.addEnhancementDecal(theCard, enhancementType, abilityCard.enhancements[chosenIndex])
  for k,v in pairs(getBaseOptions()) do
    self.UI.setAttribute(k, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("panel_" .. k, "active", false)
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("Position" .. chosenIndex, "active", false)

  if abilityCard.enhancements[chosenIndex].side == "T" then
    table.insert(existingEnhancements.top, chosenIndex)
  else
    table.insert(existingEnhancements.bottom, chosenIndex)
  end

  chosenIndex = nil

end

function getEnhancementOptions(enhancement)
  local options = EnhancementForAbility[enhancement.type]
  local available = getBaseOptions()

  -- non mainline abilities can't have anything other than +1, i think
  if not enhancement.main then
    available.Plus1 = true
    return available
  end

  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.BUFF) then
    available.Buff = true
  end
  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.CONDITION) then
    available.PWC = true
    available.Muddle = true
    available.Immobilize = true
    available.Disarm = true
  end
  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.HEX) then
    available.Hex = true
  end
  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.JUMP) then
    available.Jump = true
  end
  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.ELEMENT) then
    available.Element = true
    available.AnyElement = true
  end
  if TableUtil.contains(options, EnhancementType.PLUS) then
    available.Plus1 = true
  end
  return available
end

function getBaseOptions()
  return {
    Plus1 = false,
    PWC = false,
    Muddle = false,
    Immobilize = false,
    Disarm = false,
    Buff = false,
    Jump = false,
    Element = false,
    AnyElement = false,
    Hex = false,
  }
end

function reset()
  theCard = nil
  className = nil
  abilityCard = {}

  existingEnhancements = {
    top = {},
    bottom = {},
  }

  for k,v in pairs(getBaseOptions()) do
    self.UI.setAttribute(k, "text", "")
  end
  for k=1,8 do
    self.UI.setAttribute("Position" .. k, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute("Selected" .. k, "active", false)
  end
end

end)

---@param decalPosition tts__Vector
---@param enhancementInfo gh_Game_Ability_Enhancement[]
---@return (number, number)
function Enhancements.findNearestIndex(decalPosition, enhancementInfo)
    local nearestDistance = 42
    local nearestIndex = 1
    decalPosition:setAt("y", 0)
    for i, enhancement in ipairs(enhancementInfo) do
        local x, z = enhancement.position[1], enhancement.position[2]
        local distance = decalPosition:distance(Vector(x, 0, z))
        if distance < nearestDistance then
            nearestDistance = distance
            nearestIndex = i
        end
    end

    return nearestIndex, nearestDistance
end

function Enhancements.addNumberDecal(obj, name, info)
    position = { info.position[1], DecalYCoordinate, info.position[2] }
    obj.addDecal({
        name = tostring(name),
        url = Enhancements.Decals[name],
        position = position,
        rotation = { 90, 180, 0 },
        scale = { 0.16, 0.16, 3.08 }
    })
end
function Enhancements.addEnhancementDecal(obj, name, info)
    position = { info.position[1], DecalYCoordinate, info.position[2] }
    obj.addDecal({
        name = "Enhancement " .. tostring(name),
        url = Enhancements.Decals[name],
        position = position,
        rotation = { 90, 180, 0 },
        scale = { 0.16, 0.16, 3.08 }
    })
end

function Enhancements.removeDecalsByName(card, name)
  local decals = Object.decals(card)
  local decalsToKeep = {}
  for i, decal in ipairs(decals) do
      if not decal.name:find(tostring(name)) then
        table.insert(decalsToKeep, decal)
      end
  end
  card.setDecals(decalsToKeep)
end



function Enhancements.removeNonEnhancementDecals(card)
  local decals = Object.decals(card)
  local decalsToKeep = {}
  for i, decal in ipairs(decals) do
      if decal.name:find("Enhancement ") then
        table.insert(decalsToKeep, decal)
      end
  end
  card.setDecals(decalsToKeep)
end

return Enhancements

	end

   buttons.count = 0

   buttons.toggleA = {
      width = 300, height = 300, font = 400
   }
   buttons.toggleB = {
      width = 200, height = 200, font = 250
   }
end

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["xp"] = self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["gold"] = self.UI.getAttribute("gold", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Items"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Items", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["NotesFront"] = self.UI.getAttribute("NotesFront", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Notes"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Notes", "text")

   saved_data = JSON.encode_pretty(data_to_save)
   -- saved_data = ""
   self.script_state = saved_data
   return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
   initButtonsTable()
   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         1)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()
end

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else
      buttons[index].label = ""
   end
   self.editButton(buttons[index])
   forceSave()
end

end

function setupButton(name, type, x, z)
   local button_parameters = {}
   button_parameters.index = buttons.count
   button_parameters.height = buttons[type].height
   button_parameters.width = buttons[type].width
   button_parameters.font_size = buttons[type].font
   if type == "toggleA" or type == "toggleB" then
      self.setVar("toggleClick_" .. name, function () clickedToggle(name) end)
      button_parameters.click_function = "toggleClick_" .. name
      button_parameters.label = ""
   end

   if hideButtonBack then
      button_parameters.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
      button_parameters.font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}
   end
   button_parameters.scale = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1}
   button_parameters.position = {x, thick, z}
   button_parameters.function_owner = self

   if buttons[name] ~= nil then
      if buttons[name].label == "u{2717}" then
         button_parameters.label = toggleSymbol
      else
         button_parameters.label = buttons[name].label
      end
   end

   self.createButton(button_parameters)
   buttons[name] = button_parameters
   buttons.count = buttons.count + 1
end

function addEx(params) add(params.name, params.amount) end

function onClick(player, value, id)
   add(value:sub(1,-2), value:sub(-1) == "+" and 1 or - 1)
end

function add(name, amount)
	local newValue = math.max((tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute(name, "text")) + amount), 0)
	self.UI.setAttribute(name, "text", newValue)
   level = 0
   if name == "xp" then
      if newValue >= 500 then
         level = 9
      elseif newValue >= 420 then
         level = 8
      elseif newValue >= 345 then
         level = 7
      elseif newValue >= 275 then
         level = 6
      elseif newValue >= 210 then
         level = 5
      elseif newValue >= 150 then
         level = 4
      elseif newValue >= 95 then
         level = 3
      elseif newValue >= 45 then
         level = 2
      end
      if level > 0 then
         if buttons["level" .. level].label == "" then Wait.frames(function() clickedToggle("level" .. level) end, 1) end
      end
   end
   Wait.frames(forceSave, 10)
end

info = {
  hpColour = "#D88A27",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function initialize()
    for i = 1, #colorList do
        rspValue[colorList[i]] = nil
        marker[colorList[i]] = '<textcolor color="#' .. colorCode[colorList[i]] .. '">■</textcolor>'
    end
end

function addParticipants(color)
    if string.find(participantsStr, colorCode[color]) then
    else
        participantsStr = participantsStr .. marker[color]
    end
    self.UI.setValue('uistring', participantsStr)
    self.UI.setAttribute('text1', 'active', 'true')
end

function removeParticipants(color)
    if string.find(participantsStr, colorCode[color]) then
        participantsStr = string.gsub(participantsStr, marker[color], '')
    else
    end
    self.UI.setValue('uistring', participantsStr)
end

function use_s(player_color, position, object)
    if player_color == 'Grey' then
        return
    end
    if rspValue[player_color] == nil then
        addParticipants(player_color)
    end
    rspValue[player_color] = '가위'
    if Player[player_color].seated == true then
        broadcastToColor('당신은 가위를 냈습니다.', player_color)
    end
end
function use_r(player_color, position, object)
    if player_color == 'Grey' then
        return
    end
    if rspValue[player_color] == nil then
        addParticipants(player_color)
    end
    rspValue[player_color] = '바위'
    if Player[player_color].seated == true then
        broadcastToColor('당신은 바위를 냈습니다.', player_color)
    end
end
function use_p(player_color, position, object)
    if player_color == 'Grey' then
        return
    end
    if rspValue[player_color] == nil then
        addParticipants(player_color)
    end
    rspValue[player_color] = '보'
    if Player[player_color].seated == true then
        broadcastToColor('당신은 보를 냈습니다.', player_color)
    end
end
function cancel(player_color, position, object)
    if player_color == 'Grey' then
        return
    end
    if rspValue[player_color] ~= nil then
        removeParticipants(player_color)
    end
    rspValue[player_color] = nil
    if Player[player_color].seated == true then
        broadcastToColor('당신은 아무것도 내지 않습니다.', player_color)
    end
end

function run(player_color, position, object)
    local swr = 0
    local sws = 0
    local swp = 0
    local draw = 0
    local winner_r = 0
    local winner_s = 0
    local winner_p = 0
    local winner_list = '승자 :'

info = {
  hpColour = "#F2C23A",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function findManager()
    local withTag = getObjectsWithTag("Gloomhaven - Campaign Manager")
    if withTag == nil then
        return nil
    end

    return withTag[1]
end

---@param functionName string
---@param parameters table
---@return boolean
function performOnManager(functionName, parameters)
    local manager = findManager()
    if not manager then
        printToAll("Can not find the Gloomhaven Campaign Manager! In order to execute this function its presence is required. Add it somewhere on the table and try again.", { r=1, g=0, b=0 })

    else
        manager.call(functionName, parameters)

    end

info = {
  hpColour = "#F2C23A",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")

   initButtonsTable()
   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         1)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()
end

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else
      buttons[index].label = ""
   end
   self.editButton(buttons[index])
   forceSave()
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#5080C1",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

function initButtonsTable()
   buttons = {}
   buttons.count = 0

   buttons.toggleA = {
      width = 300, height = 300, font = 400
   }
   buttons.toggleB = {
      width = 200, height = 200, font = 250
   }
end

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["xp"] = self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["gold"] = self.UI.getAttribute("gold", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Items"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Items", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["NotesFront"] = self.UI.getAttribute("NotesFront", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Notes"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Notes", "text")

   saved_data = JSON.encode_pretty(data_to_save)
   -- saved_data = ""
   self.script_state = saved_data
   return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
   initButtonsTable()
   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         1)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()
end

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else
      buttons[index].label = ""
   end
   self.editButton(buttons[index])
   forceSave()
end

function onValueChanged(player, value, id)
   self.UI.setAttribute(id, "text", value)
end

function onEndEdit(player, value, id)
   forceSave()
end

function setupButton(name, type, x, z)
   local button_parameters = {}
   button_parameters.index = buttons.count
   button_parameters.height = buttons[type].height
   button_parameters.width = buttons[type].width
   button_parameters.font_size = buttons[type].font
   if type == "toggleA" or type == "toggleB" then
      self.setVar("toggleClick_" .. name, function () clickedToggle(name) end)
      button_parameters.click_function = "toggleClick_" .. name
      button_parameters.label = ""
   end

   if hideButtonBack then
      button_parameters.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
      button_parameters.font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}
   end
   button_parameters.scale = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1}
   button_parameters.position = {x, thick, z}
   button_parameters.function_owner = self

   if buttons[name] ~= nil then
      if buttons[name].label == "u{2717}" then
         button_parameters.label = toggleSymbol
      else
         button_parameters.label = buttons[name].label
      end
   end

   self.createButton(button_parameters)
   buttons[name] = button_parameters
   buttons.count = buttons.count + 1
end

function addEx(params) add(params.name, params.amount) end

function onClick(player, value, id)
   add(value:sub(1,-2), value:sub(-1) == "+" and 1 or - 1)
end

function add(name, amount)
	local newValue = math.max((tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute(name, "text")) + amount), 0)
	self.UI.setAttribute(name, "text", newValue)
   level = 0
   if name == "xp" then
      if newValue >= 500 then
         level = 9
      elseif newValue >= 420 then
         level = 8
      elseif newValue >= 345 then
         level = 7
      elseif newValue >= 275 then
         level = 6
      elseif newValue >= 210 then
         level = 5
      elseif newValue >= 150 then
         level = 4
      elseif newValue >= 95 then
         level = 3
      elseif newValue >= 45 then
         level = 2
      end
      if level > 0 then
         if buttons["level" .. level].label == "" then Wait.frames(function() clickedToggle("level" .. level) end, 1) end
      end
   end
   Wait.frames(forceSave, 10)
end
