ObjectStates.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#5080C1",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

allowedCard = "Attack Modifier (-1)*"
----#include Shared/FilterDeck
function filterObjectEnter(enter_object)
    if enter_object.tag == 'Card' and enter_object.getName() == allowedCard then
        return true
    end
    if enter_object.tag == 'Deck' then
        filterDeck(enter_object)
    end
    return false
end

function filterDeck(deck)
    local remaining = #deck.getObjects()
    for index, card in pairs(deck.getObjects()) do
        if card.name == allowedCard then
            if remaining > 1 then
                -- last item will go in automatically, if allowed
                self.putObject(deck.takeObject({guid = card.guid}))
            end
            remaining = remaining - 1
        end
    end
end

function initButtonsTable()

   }
end

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["xp"] = self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["gold"] = self.UI.getAttribute("gold", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Items"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Items", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["NotesFront"] = self.UI.getAttribute("NotesFront", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Notes"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Notes", "text")

   saved_data = JSON.encode_pretty(data_to_save)
   -- saved_data = ""
   self.script_state = saved_data
   return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
   initButtonsTable()
   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         1)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()
end

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else
      buttons[index].label = ""
   end
   self.editButton(buttons[index])
   forceSave()
end

function onValueChanged(player, value, id)
   self.UI.setAttribute(id, "text", value)
end

function onEndEdit(player, value, id)
   forceSave()
end

function setupButton(name, type, x, z)
   local button_parameters = {}
   button_parameters.index = buttons.count
   button_parameters.height = buttons[type].height
   button_parameters.width = buttons[type].width
   button_parameters.font_size = buttons[type].font
   if type == "toggleA" or type == "toggleB" then
      self.setVar("toggleClick_" .. name, function () clickedToggle(name) end)
      button_parameters.click_function = "toggleClick_" .. name
      button_parameters.label = ""
   end

   if hideButtonBack then
      button_parameters.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
      button_parameters.font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}
   end
   button_parameters.scale = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1}
   button_parameters.position = {x, thick, z}
   button_parameters.function_owner = self

   if buttons[name] ~= nil then
      if buttons[name].label == "u{2717}" then
         button_parameters.label = toggleSymbol
      else
         button_parameters.label = buttons[name].label
      end
   end

   self.createButton(button_parameters)
   buttons[name] = button_parameters
   buttons.count = buttons.count + 1
end

function addEx(params) add(params.name, params.amount) end

function onClick(player, value, id)
   add(value:sub(1,-2), value:sub(-1) == "+" and 1 or - 1)
end

function add(name, amount)
	local newValue = math.max((tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute(name, "text")) + amount), 0)
	self.UI.setAttribute(name, "text", newValue)
   level = 0
   if name == "xp" then
      if newValue >= 500 then
         level = 9
      elseif newValue >= 420 then
         level = 8
      elseif newValue >= 345 then
         level = 7
      elseif newValue >= 275 then
         level = 6
      elseif newValue >= 210 then
         level = 5
      elseif newValue >= 150 then
         level = 4
      elseif newValue >= 95 then
         level = 3
      elseif newValue >= 45 then
         level = 2
      end
      if level > 0 then
         if buttons["level" .. level].label == "" then Wait.frames(function() clickedToggle("level" .. level) end, 1) end
      end
   end
   Wait.frames(forceSave, 10)
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#E0DECB",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#6E9299",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    -- getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + 50)
end

function initButtonsTable()
   buttons = {}
   buttons.count = 0

   buttons.toggleA = {
      width = 300, height = 300, font = 400
   }
   buttons.toggleB = {
      width = 200, height = 200, font = 250
   }
end

function forceSave()
   local data_to_save = {buttons = {}, ui = {}, notesVisibility = ""}
   for i, v in pairs(buttons) do
      if i ~= "count" then
         if v.label == toggleSymbol then
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = "u{2717}"
         else
            data_to_save.buttons[i] = v.label
         end
      end
   end
   data_to_save.ui["Name"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Name", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["xp"] = self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["gold"] = self.UI.getAttribute("gold", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Items"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Items", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["NotesFront"] = self.UI.getAttribute("NotesFront", "text")
   data_to_save.ui["Notes"] = self.UI.getAttribute("Notes", "text")

   saved_data = JSON.encode_pretty(data_to_save)
   -- saved_data = ""
   self.script_state = saved_data
   return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
   initButtonsTable()
   loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
   if loaded_data ~= nil then
      for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.buttons) do
         buttons[i] = {label = v}
      end
      if loaded_data.ui ~= nil then
         Wait.frames(
            function()
               for i, v in pairs(loaded_data.ui) do
                  self.UI.setAttribute(i, "text", v)
               end
               local zoneToColor = getObjectFromGUID(scriptsToken).getTable("zoneToColor")
               found = ""
               for guid, color in pairs(zoneToColor) do
                  for _, obj in pairs(getObjectFromGUID(guid).getObjects()) do
                     if obj == self then
                        found = color
                        break
                     end
                  end
                  if found ~= "" then break end
               end
               self.UI.setAttribute("Notes", "visibility", found)
            end,
         1)
      end
   end
   initCustomButtons()
end

function clickedToggle(index)
   if buttons[index].label == "" then
      buttons[index].label = toggleSymbol
      if index:find("level") then
         if tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute("xp", "text")) < XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))] then
            self.UI.setAttribute("xp", "text", XPLevel[tonumber(index:sub(6))])
         end
         for i = 1, tonumber(index:sub(6)) do
            buttons["level" .. i].label = toggleSymbol
            self.editButton(buttons["level" .. i])
         end
      end
   else
      buttons[index].label = ""
   end
   self.editButton(buttons[index])
   forceSave()
end

function onValueChanged(player, value, id)
   self.UI.setAttribute(id, "text", value)
end

function onEndEdit(player, value, id)
   forceSave()
end

function setupButton(name, type, x, z)
   local button_parameters = {}
   button_parameters.index = buttons.count
   button_parameters.height = buttons[type].height
   button_parameters.width = buttons[type].width
   button_parameters.font_size = buttons[type].font
   if type == "toggleA" or type == "toggleB" then
      self.setVar("toggleClick_" .. name, function () clickedToggle(name) end)
      button_parameters.click_function = "toggleClick_" .. name
      button_parameters.label = ""
   end

   if hideButtonBack then
      button_parameters.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
      button_parameters.font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}
   end
   button_parameters.scale = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1}
   button_parameters.position = {x, thick, z}
   button_parameters.function_owner = self

   if buttons[name] ~= nil then
      if buttons[name].label == "u{2717}" then
         button_parameters.label = toggleSymbol
      else
         button_parameters.label = buttons[name].label
      end
   end

   self.createButton(button_parameters)
   buttons[name] = button_parameters
   buttons.count = buttons.count + 1
end

function addEx(params) add(params.name, params.amount) end

function onClick(player, value, id)
   add(value:sub(1,-2), value:sub(-1) == "+" and 1 or - 1)
end

function add(name, amount)
	local newValue = math.max((tonumber(self.UI.getAttribute(name, "text")) + amount), 0)
	self.UI.setAttribute(name, "text", newValue)
   level = 0
   if name == "xp" then
      if newValue >= 500 then
         level = 9
      elseif newValue >= 420 then
         level = 8
      elseif newValue >= 345 then
         level = 7
      elseif newValue >= 275 then
         level = 6
      elseif newValue >= 210 then
         level = 5
      elseif newValue >= 150 then
         level = 4
      elseif newValue >= 95 then
         level = 3
      elseif newValue >= 45 then
         level = 2
      end
      if level > 0 then
         if buttons["level" .. level].label == "" then Wait.frames(function() clickedToggle("level" .. level) end, 1) end
      end
   end
   Wait.frames(forceSave, 10)
end

info = {
  hpColour = "#B71C1C",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

info = {
  hpColour = "#EA6FA3",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = false
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

  buttonLabels = false

   value = nil,

}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)

    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() != "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus, width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 0, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + Global.getTable("envelopes")[self.getName()].HPBarOffset)
end

    else

function onLoad(encoded_state)
    math.randomseed(os.time())
    state = JSON.decode(encoded_state)
    Wait.frames(function()
        if state ~= nil and state.numPie ~= nil then
            numPie = state.numPie
            self.UI.setAttribute('probMap', 'image', pieImageList[numPie])
        else
            numPie = 1
        end
    end, 20)
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({numPie = numPie})
end

function tryObjectEnter()
    return false
end

function onFixedUpdate()
    if needlePower > 0 then
        local cps
        needleAngle = needleAngle + needlePower;
        if needleAngle >= 360.0 then
            needleAngle = needleAngle - 360.0;
        end
        self.UI.setAttribute('rlneedle', 'rotation', '0 0 '..tostring(needleAngle));
        cps = needlePower / 130
        needlePower = needlePower - cps - 0.03
        if needlePower <= 0 then -- end of spin
            local res = math.floor(needleAngle / 360.0 * numPie) + 1
            if spinner_color == nil or spinner_color == 'Black' then
                broadcastToAll("Spin Result: "..tostring(res).." ("..spinner_name..")", {0, 1, 1})
            else
                broadcastToAll("Spin Result: "..tostring(res).." ("..spinner_name..")", spinner_color)
            end
        end
    end
end

function rlSpinBtClick(player, value, id)
    if needlePower <= 0 then
        needleAngle = math.random(0, 3599) / 10
        needlePower = math.random(40, 75)
        spinner_name = player.steam_name
        spinner_color = player.color
    end
end

function rlSettingBtClick(player, value, id)
    player.showInputDialog("Enter the number of segments (2-100):", 
    function (text, player_color)
        local resnum = tonumber(text)
        if resnum == nil then
            return
        elseif resnum < 1 or resnum > 100 then
            player.showInfoDialog("Please enter a number between 2 and 100.")
            return
        else
            numPie = resnum
            onLoad(JSON.encode({numPie = numPie}))
        end
    end
    )
end
